7.3.3 Event kind
There are two different types of events:
• BSW-related events (reported via C-API - Dem_SetEventStatus)
• SW-C-related events (reported via RTE operation - SetEventStatus) This kind is configurable per event (refer to DemEventKind in DemEventParameter). This is necessary because BSW-events may be reported prior to full Dem initialization and need to be buffered (refer to chapter 7.8).
